data.name: HelpText
data.value:
ShaderRipper — DXBC assembly / GLSL source -> ShaderLab/CG
Usage: ShaderRipper.exe --data <game _Data dir> [--out <output dir>] [options] ShaderRipper.exe <game _Data dir> <output dir> [options] (positional form, kept for compatibility)
Required: --data <dir> Game data directory (containing resources.assets); or set env var SHADERRIPPER_DATA
Output: --out <dir> Output directory; default ./<game name>_ShaderLabs (game name from app.info) or set env var SHADERRIPPER_OUT
Resources (root of schema/data): --root <dir> Explicit path; by default searches upward from the exe dir, then the working directory, for a directory containing schema/ or data/ (or ShaderRipper.csproj) or set env var SHADERRIPPER_ROOT --schema <file|dir> Shader type tree (auto-selected by SerializedFile version by default) --names <dir> $Globals fix-up table directory (not loaded by default; pass only when row names are missing) --builtin-index <f> Built-in shader list (default data/unity_builtin_shaders.txt) --matrix-names <f> float4x4 name list (default data/unity_matrix_names.txt) --tmp-layouts <dir> $Globals layout table directory (default data/tmp_layouts)
Filtering/debug: --only <substr> Only process shaders whose name contains this substring --dump [substr] Print blob/param-block info only, write no output --list-shaders <file> List all shader names in a SerializedFile --bundles [dir] Scan asset bundles, optionally in another directory (default same as --data) --platform <id|name> Force a backend (d3d11/d3d9/gles3/gles20/openglcore/metal/vulkan...); default picks d3d11 (assembly -> Cg transliteration); GLSL source from GLES3/GLES2/OpenGLCore/legacy GL is translated back to CGPROGRAM by the built-in translator and auto-selected when no d3d11 slot exists; d3d9 (SM2/3) and D3D12 (DXIL) get native disassembly only, into Disassembly/; Metal/Vulkan are also reference-only --asm Emit per-instruction disassembly comments (default off); d3d11 = DXBC instruction comments, glsl/gles = original GLSL line comments, d3d9/d3d12 = native disassembly (into comments and Disassembly/) --no-tmp-layout Do not use the $Globals layout tables (TMP row numbers stay numeric)
Diagnostics: --selftest-d3d9 Compile known HLSL to SM2/3 and self-test the disassembler --disasm <file> Disassemble a single program file (DXBC/DXIL container or d3d9 token stream) --glsl2cg <file> Translate a single GLSL file back to Cg (add --asm for original-line comments) --lang <en|zh> UI language (default: system UI language) -h, --help Show this help
